evidence_boundary: M18 adds a conservative structural JavaScript/TypeScript analyzer for .js, .mjs, .cjs, .ts, .mts, and .cts. Accepted M18 rules are limited to opposite boolean-return simplification and hardcoded credential-like quoted literals. The final adversarial corpus contains 13 cases and proves 6 TP / 0 FP / 0 FN with precision=1.0 and recall=1.0 on Ubuntu, macOS, and Windows. Existing Go, Python, MCP, and release/install lanes remain regression evidence. M18 does not prove a full JavaScript/TypeScript parser or AST, JSX/TSX support, dead-code safety, BLOAT/LOGIC rules, template-interpolation credential semantics, or general semantic completeness. Public v0.1.0 remains an immutable historical release baseline.
